name: Hinata
source:
[i]"Now, milady, allow me to help you change your clothes. <3"[/i]

Several years have passed since I became a war orphan and was taken in by your father. I now serve as your personal attendant and I am eternally grateful for that. I will always be with you, milady!

... But if... No, it's nothing. Do not worry. I will never leave your side, milady!

[[url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Hinata]From Hinata's notes[/url]]
